paragraphs: A modest-fashion color studio built on Sanzo Wada's A Dictionary of Color Combinations (1933; Seigensha edition): 159 colors and 348 combinations. Plan capsules, preview every color live on studio photos of real garments, keep your wardrobe, saved looks, lookbooks and week plan, and sync them between devices with an optional account.

Tell it how many abayas and hijabs you want to buy, and it picks the colors that give you the most outfits. Every outfit it suggests is a pairing printed together in the book, labelled with its combination number.
features: Color sources: Wada's book (348 combinations) is the default. Switch on Chromotome (165 palettes) and ColourLovers via nice-color-palettes (991 palettes) for up to 1,504 combinations and 873 colors. Palette colors…

Capsule planner: choose the number of abayas (1–3) and hijabs (1–6), an abaya tone and a hijab mood. A hill-climbing optimizer with random restarts finds the color set with the most valid abaya + hijab pairings and…
Colors you own: lock any slot to a color you already have. You can also match your fabric with a color picker; it finds the nearest book color by CIELAB distance.
Results: a shopping list (hex + CMYK), a pairing matrix, a lookbook of figures in a long khimar and balloon-sleeve abaya with styling notes, and a 7-day rotation (Saturday to Friday).
Outfit finder: every book combination that includes a chosen color, drawn on the figure, with swappable roles.
